takes.title: Turn in Place with Cross-Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-step and uses small crossing steps to turn through several headings, briefly swinging the arms out. The take ends with another step still in progress.
takes.reviewNote: Exact BVH match to 106_06, whose visual pass found small cross-steps and turns. The original Jump Twist label differs. Check denser playback for a jump.
